description: Architecture graph for the Elite Dangerous Power Play Analyzer. Updated whenever services, tables, or data flows change.

nodes.label: Spansh Ingest
nodes.description: Polls Spansh search API every 24h for all 12 powers. Stores PP snapshots (reinforcement, undermining, control_progress) per system. Also fetches multi-power Unoccupied (Contested) systems in a second pass.

nodes.label: EDDN Listener
nodes.description: Subscribes to EDDN ZeroMQ relay (tcp://eddn.edcd.io:9500), filters for PowerplayMerits journal events. Deduplicates by messageID, resolves system_id64 from pp_systems, inserts raw events into pp_powerplay_events. Runs as isolated k8s deployment.

nodes.label: Realtime Accumulator
nodes.description: Runs every 60s via APScheduler. For each (power, system) pair, sums EDDN merits received since the last Spansh snapshot boundary. Converts merits to CPs at 4:1 ratio. Determines orientation (reinforcement vs undermining) based on controlling power. UPSERTs pp_realtime_state.

nodes.label: Scoring Engine
nodes.description: Computes fortify/expand recommendations from Spansh snapshots + optional realtime deltas. Uses urgency model (days-to-failure, progress thresholds) for fortify scoring. Merit-proximity scoring for expand targets. Weights configurable via admin_settings.

nodes.label: CP Decay Service
nodes.description: Computes estimated CP merit decay once per cycle per system. Only for Stronghold/Fortified/Exploited states. Decay is stored in pp_system_snapshots.cp_decay.

nodes.label: EDSM Sync
nodes.description: Syncs faction influence data from EDSM API for systems already in the DB. Rate-limited to 1 req/sec.

nodes.label: pp_systems
nodes.description: One row per unique star system. Upserted each ingest by system_id64. Stores name, coordinates (x/y/z), allegiance, population.

nodes.label: pp_system_snapshots
nodes.description: Insert-only time-series of Spansh PP data per system per ingest run. Never updated — each run appends new rows. Contains reinforcement, undermining, control_progress, power_state, spansh_updated_at, cp_decay.

nodes.label: pp_powerplay_events
nodes.description: Raw EDDN PowerplayMerits events (insert-only). Each row is a single player merit-earning event. Deduplicated by message_id. 30-day retention policy.

nodes.label: pp_realtime_state
nodes.description: Accumulated real-time CP deltas per (power, system). UPSERTed every 60s by the accumulator. Stores merits since last Spansh boundary, CPs converted at 4:1, split into reinforcement/undermining based on orientation.

nodes.label: spansh_enrichment
nodes.description: Cached Spansh body/faction enrichment data per system. has_platinum, has_boom, has_pristine. First-access cache, no TTL.

nodes.label: ingestion_runs
nodes.description: Audit log for each Spansh/EDSM ingestion job. Tracks source, status, started_at, completed_at, records_processed.

nodes.label: admin_settings
nodes.description: Key/value store for scoring weights and app configuration. Tunable via admin panel.

nodes.label: admin_users
nodes.description: Admin accounts for JWT-gated admin panel.

nodes.label: Spansh API
nodes.description: https://spansh.co.uk/api/systems/search — PP system data with controlling_power filter. Also /api/system/{id64}, /api/body/{id64}, /api/dump/{id64}, /api/bodies/search for enrichment.

nodes.label: EDDN ZeroMQ Relay
nodes.description: tcp://eddn.edcd.io:9500 — Public EDDN relay. Schema: journal/1. Forwards all ED journal events including PowerplayMerits.

nodes.label: EDSM API
nodes.description: https://www.edsm.net/api-v1/system — Faction influence and PP state per system. Rate-limited ~1 req/sec.

nodes.label: GET /api/powers/{name}
nodes.description: Returns all systems for a power with latest PP state, recommendations, contested systems, and realtime data.

nodes.label: GET /api/powers/{name}/realtime
nodes.description: Returns effective (blended) values: Spansh base + EDDN realtime deltas. Includes live flag and EST badge data.

nodes.label: GET /api/architecture/schema
nodes.description: Returns the full architecture graph JSON. Admin-only.

nodes.label: POST /api/admin/ingest/spansh
nodes.description: Manually trigger Spansh ingestion. Admin-only. Runs as background task.

nodes.label: POST /api/spansh/enrich/batch
nodes.description: Batch enrichment: returns cached PLAT/BOOM/PRISTINE data, fetching from Spansh on cache miss.

nodes.label: React Frontend
nodes.description: React + TypeScript + Vite SPA. Views: TableView, TargetListView, Map2D, Map3D, AdminPage, ArchitecturePage. Served via nginx.
